query:
MATCH (u:User)-[:HasProfileArtifact]->(a:ProfileArtifact)-[fo:FoundOn]->(c:Computer)
WHERE coalesce(fo.partial, false) = true OR coalesce(fo.collectionlimited, false) = true OR coalesce(fo.errorcount, 0) > 0
RETURN u.name AS User, a.artifacttype AS ArtifactType, a.category AS Category, c.name AS Computer, fo.profilepaths AS ProfilePaths, fo.partial AS Partial, fo.collectionlimited AS CollectionLimited, fo.collectionlimitreason AS CollectionLimitReason, fo.collectionlimitreasons AS CollectionLimitReasons, fo.errorcount AS ErrorCount
ORDER BY ErrorCount DESC, User, ArtifactType
name: Profilehound - Incomplete Artifact Collections
description: Shows artifact evidence where collection was partial, limited, or produced errors.
